machine part's HP (health points).\""},{"statement":"Each machine part die is turned so its showing face equals the HP value indicated on that machine part card.","sourceSentence":"\"6) Take one cubes","approximate":false}},{"statement":"In the layout, the Machine Deck sits to the right of the Doom Machine Tracker and is face down.","sourceSentence":"To its right, a portrait card labeled \"B\" (the face-down Machine Deck)."},{"statement":"The three starting machine part cards sit in a row to the right of the Machine Deck, each carrying one yellow machine part die.","sourceSentence":"To the right of B are three blank portrait card outlines in a line, the middle one labeled \"D\", each with a small yellow die drawn on it and a short underline beneath — these are the 3 starting machine part cards, each carrying a machine part die (\"E\").","numericValue":{"magnitude":3,"unit":"starting machine part cards","approximate":false}},{"statement":"The Player HP Tracker with its cube is positioned below and to the left of the row of cards.","sourceSentence":"Below and left of the row sits a portrait card labeled \"C\" (Player HP Tracker) with a small cube;"},{"statement":"The extra machine dice pool is a loose cluster of yellow dice placed to the left of the Player HP Tracker.","sourceSentence":"to its left is a loose cluster of yellow dice (\"F\", the extra machine dice pool) drawn as a grid of small yellow squares."},{"statement":"The player's starting black dice sit beneath the extra yellow machine dice pool.","sourceSentence":"Beneath that cluster is a small group of black dice (\"G\", the starting player dice)."}]}
